2608.04240.title: Hallucinations on the Board: Tool-Augmented Evaluation of LLM Chess Commentary
2608.04240.paper_summary: Superhuman game engines in domains like chess have made expert-level evaluations easily accessible, yet they communicate what is true without the natural-language explanations that make such expertise educationally useful to experts and non-experts alike. Large language models could, in principle, bridge this gap, but they frequently hallucinate due to limited domain-specific knowledge, and standard reference-based or LLM-as-a-judge frameworks cannot reliably detect these errors. In this work, we present ACT-Eval, an evaluation framework that decomposes chess commentary into atomic claims and routes them to engine-supported tools and expert-annotated gold references to assess factual correctness, conceptual coverage, and move-quality judgment. We release a benchmark of 325 position--move pairs spanning pedagogical, tournament, and critical positions, including 125 positions with expert-verified gold atoms and a five-class error taxonomy. Evaluating leading proprietary and open-weight models, we find that factual hallucinations remain pervasive in chess commentary: GPT-5.4 without tools produces incorrect sub-claims 22.0% of the time, while smaller open-weight models exceed 40%. Although tool augmentation substantially improves factual correctness and move-quality assessment, coverage of expert strategic and tactical ideas remains limited across all models. Human calibration shows that ACT-Eval's factual judgments fall within the observed range of inter-human agreement, while its coverage scores correlate strongly with human assessments of strategic completeness.
2608.04240.paper_summary_zh: 超人類的遊戲引擎在像棋類這樣的領域中，使得專家級的評估變得輕而易舉，但它們所傳達的真實信息並沒有以自然語言的解釋來使這種專業知識對專家和非專家都具有教育意義。大型語言模型在原則上可以彌補這一差距，但由於領域特定知識的有限，它們經常會產生幻覺，而基於標準參考或 LLM 作為評判的框架無法可靠地檢測這些錯誤。在這項工作中，我們提出了 ACT-Eval，一個評估框架，將棋類評論分解為原子聲明，並將其路由到引擎支持的工具和專家標註的金標準參考，以評估事實正確性、概念覆蓋和走棋質量判斷。我們發布了一個包含 325 對位置-走棋的基準，涵蓋了教學、比賽和關鍵位置，其中包括 125 個經專家驗證的金原子和五類錯誤分類。對領先的專有模型和開放權重模型進行評估，我們發現棋類評論中的事實幻覺仍然普遍存在：未使用工具的 GPT-5.4 產生不正確的子聲明的頻率為 22.0%，而較小的開放權重模型則超過 40%。儘管工具增強大幅改善了事實正確性和走棋質量評估，但所有模型在專家戰略和戰術思想的覆蓋上仍然有限。人類校準顯示 ACT-Eval 的事實判斷落在觀察到的人際一致性範圍內，而其覆蓋分數與人類對戰略完整性的評估強相關。
